description: Parameters of the experiments reported in the paper. The scripts define these values in code (see 'source'); tests/test_config.py checks that this file, config/final_mapping.csv and the code agree.

seeds.synthetic: seed s: environment seed s (utility draw and feedback noise), algorithm seed s + 10000 (restarts, tie-breaking, random partitions); instances are paired across methods
seeds.datasets: seed s: data points sampled with SHA-256(s || 'bm|<dataset>|<sampler>|n<n>|subset'); environment and algorithm seeds derived from the same tag with '|env' and '|algorithm' (sns/seeding.py)

heuristic.name: SOLVE: greedy local search with random restarts, local optima rescored with the exact checker

deviation_checker: sns/full_deviation_checker.full_gap_k: exact Gap_k over the complete deviation family Lambda_C(pi), |C| <= k <= 3; installed for the learners, the pessimistic test, regret evaluation and labels

not_reported_in_paper.ucb_lcb_gs: original implementation, preserved in the historical trial records (smoke checks only)

utility_models.gaussian: mean uniform in the integers [-100, 100], then N(mean, 10^2), rounded

synthetic_grid.noise: Gaussian N(0, sigma^2), one draw per co-located pair and round
synthetic_grid.cells: config/final_mapping.csv: one row per (experiment, cell, method) with the source of its trials (new/rerun: results/saved/synthetic/trials.jsonl; reuse/preserved: results/saved/synthetic/historical_trials.csv)

labels.rule: YES if max_pi Gap_k(pi, v) >= eps; NO if max_pi Gap_k(pi, v) < 0; intermediate (Z) otherwise
labels.datasets: exact two-stage filter Gap_1 -> Gap_2, with a full exhaustive cross-check at n = 8 (scripts/benchmark_labels.py)

metrics.regret: sum_t max(0, eps - Gap_k(pi_t, v)), averaged over YES instances
metrics.existence_error: number of rounds with d_t = 0, averaged over YES instances
metrics.non_existence_error: number of rounds with d_t = 1, averaged over NO instances
metrics.intermediate_declaration_rate: fraction of rounds with d_t = 1 on intermediate instances (scored by neither error)
metrics.uncertainty: mean +- standard error over the instances of the class

settings.asymmetric: v_ij and v_ji drawn independently with the same marginals; one observation per ordered co-located pair; estimator per ordered pair
settings.student_t5: symmetric utilities; Student-t noise with 5 degrees of freedom rescaled to variance sigma^2

coalition_level_bandit.feedback: each agent i reports R_i = sum_{j in pi(i)\{i}} v_ij + eta_i, eta_i ~ N(0, sigma^2); pairwise estimates only from two-agent coalitions
coalition_level_bandit.initialization: round-robin matchings: r = n - 1 (even n) or n (odd n) rounds, every pair once
coalition_level_bandit.grid: every parameter set of the semi-bandit grid (E1, E2, E3) with 100 seeds; Random reuses its semi-bandit trajectories

datasets.construction: Csaji et al. (NeurIPS 2025): y is a friend of x if d(x, y) <= f * diam, an enemy if d(x, y) > e * diam (and not a friend), neutral otherwise; distances and diameter of the full data set (Euclidean for Iris, shortest-path length for the networks)

encodings.scale: utilities multiplied by c = floor(100 / max(|a_f|, |a_e|))

scalability.utilities: random symmetric integers in [-100, 100], numpy seed 0
scalability.stop_rule: a size is skipped once a single evaluation exceeds 60 s; SOLVE timed only if every evaluation took under 2 s
